name: a Soul Navi's own block
why: A Soul Navi's own block of his AI data is BN4's +0x64 (BN4_AI_NAVI) and BN6's +0x80 (BN6_AI_NAVI_STATE), where his port moves it (tools/xnavirecipe_bn4.py AI_BLOCKS: each pointer his code makes into it given BN6's offset) and the trace lays BN4's out (src/dev/xdiff_bn4_trace.c ai_segs). A pointer his code keeps to a byte of it is read as BN6's of the same byte: WoodMan's step's callback state (0x080C9178: movs r0,#0xb; adds r0,r0,r6; str r0,[r7,#0x20], r6 his block, BN4 0x080C8F88 adds r6,#0x64 and his copy's #0x80) points at his block's +0xB in both, BN4's AI +0x6F and BN6's +0x8B (woodman_v1 at t1: ai+0xC0 'ai' 111 | 139). A pointer to any other offset of an AI's data is read as it is

name: a Soul Navi's attack's variables
why: His attack's variables are BN4's +0x70 (BN4_AI_ATTACK_VARS) and BN6's +0xA0 (BN6_AI_ATTACK_VARS), moved and laid out as his own block is (tools/xnavirecipe_bn4.py AI_BLOCKS, src/dev/xdiff_bn4_trace.c ai_segs): a pointer into them is read as BN6's of the same byte
